name: shared-file-endpoints-owner-view-only
body: Scanner.TryResolveEndpoint maps a shared-file symbol to the owner's declaration by declaration site, so a declaration that exists only in a non-owner project's view of a shared file (behind an #if symbol the owner does not define) has no emitted declaration and references to it become unresolved. Revisit if per-project #if differences in shared files matter.
